project.project_name: Payment Integrity - TPL Inbound files ingestion to DL
project.business_context_summary: Efficient solution to enable end‑to‑end traceability of member data across multiple source systems by ingesting raw source files from state and third‑party vendors into a centralized data lake.

in_scope: CAQH TPL Inbound Files ingestion into DL
CAQH (Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare) Vendor
Expose the data to On Prem TPL Application.
out_of_scope: TPL Dashboard build, Web Based front-end application
Vendors other than listed in the ‘In Scope’

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Connectivity
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: SFG connectivity between vendors and ACFC are already established.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Format Compatibility
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The data from the various sources can be transformed into a format compatible with DL 2.0

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Consistent Data Sources
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Data sources will remain consistent and accessible.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: QA testing scope
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Source systems have limited lower environments with masked data. QA team will need to work with developers/ Architects to perform QA testing in masked environment.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: UAT signoff
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The team is expected to provide UAT signoff on the test results shared by QA team on QA data for the requirement to be finalized as per the change management process.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Source Availability
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: The availability and reliability of data sources are critical. Any changes or downtime in these sources can impact the automation process.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Data Quality Rules
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Any data quality rules outside business/ consumer requirements to be documented separately by Data quality team.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Masking
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Files should be masked prior to performing Dev & QA testing. Files masking request can be submitted to ‘DL-ACFC: IS QACoE Delphix Admin’. ETA for masking is 2 weeks.

assumptions_constraints_dependencies.name: Access
assumptions_constraints_dependencies.description: Access requests to DL 2.0 will be provided by data owner based on ticketing process.

load_windows_sla: File should be loaded before business hours 8 AM.
Files received during business hours should be loaded after 5 PM.
validation_rules: Process shall fail when file layout is not as per source dictionary.
Duplicate file name check shall be turned off as vendor may re‑send the corrected file with same file name.
Files are pipe delimited and contain incremental changes.
LOB_ID field should be mapped to ‘Payer Area’ field.
Member ID validation should be performed against Facets for existence.
Invalid records will be moved to Recycle table.
Process should load the files AS‑IS after Member ID validation and should not perform any data transformation while loading into Data Lake.
Process should populate source File name, Load timestamp, LOB ID, File type fields in the target tables.
Success and Failure Notification will be sent to the Source Prod Support team.
Email notification will be sent post job completion.
feeds.recycle_rule: Invalid records will be moved to Recycle table, retained for 15 days.
feeds.history_backfill: History files up to 3 years should be loaded into Data Lake; one‑time movement from O drive to ADLS based on start date provided by source team.
feeds.archive_retention: Files: 7 Years; Data: Corporate retention schedule.

system_interfaces: Connectivity with on Prem TPL Database (Requirement ID: SIR226434)
